about_the_game:
• Experience the horror from your own speakers…

    The Original Soundtrack by Chipzel for the indie horror game CROWDED. FOLLOWED. by NIGHT DIAL.

    Chipzel is an award winning composer, sound designer and producer from the North of Ireland. A recognised pioneer of the Chiptune scene, Chipzel’s prolific musical career has seen them touring the world, touring acclaimed chip sounds across the globe. With multiple studio albums, original videogame scores and iconic performances, Chipzel is renowned for their iconic work for Super Hexagon, Spectra and Dicey Dungeons and now HORROR with CROWDED. FOLLOWED.

    Includes 3 tracks from the game:

  • 1. CROWDED. FOLLOWED. (Title)

  • 2. Claustrophobia (Club Metro)

  • 3. Safe (The Beach)

Death will endlessly pursue. It is only a matter of time.

content_descriptors.notes: Settings are bleak and dark, but not realistic, very frightening scenes; psychological horror, jumpscares.
